q: Are you passionate about people, culture, and transformation? Do you thrive at the intersection of strategy, organisations, and human behaviour? We’re looking for a People & Change Professional who’s ready to help organisations navigate change and unlock the potential of their people.
Well, if the shoe fits, then this is the opportunity for you!

The (Assistant) Manager will join the People & Change team within Risk Consulting, with a core focus on managing and delivering HR and people transformation engagements, particularly technology-enabled transformation. The role combines HR expertise, consulting experience and practical transformation capability to help clients redesign and deliver changes to HR functions, processes, operating models, employee experience and ways of working, with technology as a key enabler.

While People & Change will be the primary area of focus, the individual will also contribute to broader Risk Consulting and Advisory engagements. The role is client-facing and requires strong engagement management, commercial awareness, relationship building and business development capability, alongside project and change management expertise.
Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience, preferably including at least 5 years in consulting/advisory, HR transformation, change management or related transformation roles.
Demonstrated experience leading or delivering HR, people or technology-enabled transformation programmes.
Strong practical project management and change management experience within transformation environments.
Experience across areas such as HR transformation, HR operating models, process redesign, digital HR, employee experience and/or HR technology.
Demonstrated experience managing client engagements or significant workstreams, including scope, timelines, resources, risks and senior stakeholder relationships.
Strong consulting capability, including structured problem solving, workshop facilitation, proposal development and business development.
Experience coaching or managing junior team members and contributing to team capability development.
Experience in the GCC / Middle East would be advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Human Capital Management, Organisational Psychology, Business Administration with an HR specialisation, or a related discipline.
Relevant professional qualification or certification in project management and/or change management.
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
Prosci, CCMP or equivalent change management certification.
CIPD, SHRM or equivalent HR professional qualification.
Formal training or certification in a major HR technology / HCM platform would be advantageous.
r: Manage and deliver HR and people transformation engagements from assessment and design through implementation, transition and adoption.
Advise clients on HR operating models, process redesign, digital HR, employee experience, HR technology opportunities and transformation roadmaps.
Assess the impact of technology and broader business transformation on people, processes, structures, roles and ways of working, translating these into practical transformation interventions.

Apply strong project management disciplines across transformation programmes, including planning, governance, stakeholder coordination, risk and issue management, dependency management and progress reporting.
Lead change management activities including change impact and readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement, communications, training, business readiness and adoption.
Build trusted relationships with senior HR, business and technology stakeholders; facilitate workshops to define priorities, shape solutions and drive decisions.
Manage engagement scope, resources, timelines, budgets, risks and quality, ensuring delivery in line with firm requirements and agreed commercial objectives.
Lead and coach engagement teams, providing clear direction, constructive feedback and development support.
Develop client and market relationships, identify opportunities arising from engagements, and contribute to proposals, presentations, thought leadership and follow-on work.

Contribute to broader Risk Consulting and Advisory engagements where relevant, applying transformation, project management, change management and consulting capabilities beyond the core People & Change portfolio.
Collaborate across Risk Consulting and other Advisory disciplines to develop integrated solutions and identify appropriate cross-functional opportunities.
Maintain awareness of developments in HR, technology and transformation and translate relevant market trends into client opportunities and new advisory solutions.

d: ADNOC Schools is currently seeking high-performing Biology Teachers for January 2027 start. The current vacancy is based in ADNOC School, Ruwais Campus, located in the Abu Dhabi UAE
ADNOC Schools are Massachusetts State Curriculum schools in superb facilities in Abu Dhabi City and the Western Region of Abu Dhabi Emirate.

The Massachusetts Curriculum is one of the most highly regarded and successful curricula in the United States, with close links to prestigious higher education institutions such as Harvard University and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Graduates of ADNOC Schools receive the US High School Diploma - the standard entry qualification for US colleges and universities.
This is an exciting opportunity to join the highly successful Aldar family of schools and to help shape the future of Abu Dhabi’s leading school group.
The successful candidates will be closely aligned with our core values and ethos and possess a genuine understanding and appreciation of the values of the region.
r: Creating a climate for learning that is conducive for outstanding practice
Identifying clear teaching and learning objectives
Setting tasks that challenge students and ensure high levels of interest;
Setting clear targets, building on prior attainment;
Identifying SEN or very able students and ensuring that their needs are met through differentiation;
Providing clear structures for lessons maintaining pace, motivation, and challenge;
Making effective use of assessment for learning;
Making effective use of performance data and key indicators to inform planning and therefore deliver differentiated lessons
Maintaining discipline in accordance with the school’s ‘Behaviour for Learning Policy’ and encouraging good practice with regard to punctuality, behavior, standards of work, and homework;
Using a variety of teaching strategies to:
i. Match approach to content, structure information, present a set of key ideas and use appropriate vocabulary
ii. Use effective questioning, listen carefully to students, give attention to errors and misconceptions
iii. Select appropriate learning resources and develop study skills through the library, I.C.T., and other learning technologies;
Assess how well learning objectives have been achieved and use them to improve specific aspects of teaching;
Mark students work at least once every two weeks and set targets for progress;
Using performance data to inform planning and therefore ensuring the Learning and Teaching continue to ‘add value’

Assess and record students' progress systematically and keep records to check work is understood and completed, monitor strengths and areas for development, inform planning and recognize the level at which the student is achieving
Assess students as requested by examination bodies, departmental and school procedures
Prepare and present informative reports to parents
Take part in subject development by producing, reviewing, and updating curriculum plans and schemes of work
Keep subject knowledge up-to-date through CPD and professional reading
Attend professional development workshops as appropriate
Undertake additional duties as required by the Principal or Vice Principal as appropriate.
You must be a fully qualified teacher with
Bachelor's in Biology, Science or a bachelor’s degree in a related subject with PGCE or other teacher qualification with a minimum of 2-year teaching experience in the related field.
A commitment to an extensive enrichment program
Recent and consistent involvement in extra-curricular activities
Respect for all members of your school community
Experience with students for whom English is an additional language
A positive and solution-focused attitude to working life
A clean enhanced Disclosure and Barring Services or Police check
A cover letter and CV including details of two referees should be submitted.
x: We offer an attractive remuneration package including medical cover, flights, furnished accommodation, and free child school places. d: You will own the digital-marketing data: the pipelines that bring advertising, social, web-analytics, email and app-store data into the warehouse, and the models that let the client see whether campaign spend turns into visitors and bookings.
Build and run connectors to advertising and social platforms, web analytics, email-marketing tools and app stores, current and future.
Normalise campaign, spend, impression, click and conversion data across platforms so it can be compared.
Maintain the attribution and UTM models and the marketing data marts that feed the dashboards and ROI analysis.
Keep the connectors healthy through API changes, rate limits and credential rotations.
Work with the marketing stakeholders to define the metrics and reconcile them with platform reports.
Write the monthly progress report for the marketing data stream.
Python connectors with pagination, rate limiting, retries and incremental loads
Hands-on experience with at least two advertising or social APIs (Meta, Google Ads, Snapchat, TikTok, X)
GA4 data model and the GA4 export to BigQuery
Email-marketing platforms and app-store download data as sources
A marketing-data connector such as Funnel.io or Supermetrics
SQL and warehouse modelling for campaign and conversion data
Attribution and UTM fundamentals: multi-touch models, campaign taxonomies, deduplication across platforms
